fantasy-icon.description: Quadratisches Icon mit einem zentrierten Symbol, transparenter Hintergrund, gut lesbar in kleiner Groesse.
fantasy-icon.prompt_prefix: Premium fantasy game UI asset. Dark obsidian core, amethyst purple accents, aged antique gold trim, controlled warm orange rim lighting. Clear, readable silhouette. High quality material detail (metal, stone, crystal, wood grain as appropriate). Cleanly isolated subject. Symmetrical composition where appropriate. Reads clearly at small UI sizes. Not photorealistic. Not a full screenshot. No surrounding UI window or app chrome. No watermark. No signature. No text. No letters. No numbers. Exactly one main subject. Generous margin from the image edge.
fantasy-icon.prompt_suffix: Square composition. A single centered symbol or icon, filling most of the frame with a bold, strong silhouette. No unnecessary background scenery or environment behind the subject. Transparent background.
